location.basis: Centre of the open mound north of Bhirana village, read on the imagery at about 29.5546 N, 75.5477 E; it coincides with the OpenStreetMap archaeological-site point 29.55491 N, 75.54778 E.

main_system_reason: No system: we found no measurable Harappan line.
notes: The Esri imagery is a Vantor Vivid mosaic from a WorldView-2 scene of 17 April 2023 with real detail to zoom 18 (0.52 m per pixel). The mound is a scrub-covered open area between fields, a road and the village; the excavations of 2003-2006 are backfilled, and we found no wall, street or drain line. The straight lines in the scene are the road, field edges and the fence of a small electrical installation. Bhirrana is not measurable from this imagery.
